purpose: 관측 수량 수준·변화를 최근 이력 보정의 반영량에 명시적으로 연결하는 것이 시간 이력만 사용하는 gate보다 유용한지 확인한다.

architecture.insertion: between B blocks at existing local-detail residual injection
architecture.residual: exact existing MultiLagDetail(mode=local), eight repeated lag1 branches, unchanged availability [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128], rank4, divisor8
architecture.initialization: all gate coefficients zero so multiplier1; original local output projections zero; preserve caller RNG, B outputs/common preclip gradients, and local initial U gradients
architecture.mask: sanitize before transforms; padding skipped; withheld valid row resets added predecessor segment, not existing B attention context
architecture.head_objective: unchanged recorded-positive-integer heteroscedastic lognormal time and log-MSE quantity, jointly trained

options.rejected_hidden_gate: hidden already mixes time and quantity, obscuring explicit quantity attribution
options.deferred_norm_cap: would confound intervention limiting with gating; gate range does not bound residual norm

prior_distinction.pair_message: rank/channel gate acts inside attention message pooling, not raw-feature scalar residual injection
prior_distinction.state_transport: hidden-based gate controls recurrent writes, not completed local residual injection

interpretation.primary: quantity gate vs time gate; exactly two extra parameters, not perfectly equal capacity
interpretation.secondary: both vs same-host B and ungated references under verified initialization/source/exposure bridge
not_established: all-quantity access versus no quantity access
causal explanation of prior late instability

guardrails: candidate must pass against temporal gate, B and ungated local reference; reuse strict raw-RMSE selector, one checkpoint for all selected metrics, last30 mean/sd and train-derived bins; no posthoc gate or dataset exclusion
claims: seed42 validation exploration only; no held-out, no universal claims

review.adopted: 2sigmoid option preserves ungated initial U gradients; two-parameter difference explicit; no norm cap
